Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony). THE MATCH MAKER: the window the base's Play Match flag opens. One row = one button, top to bottom. A match is counted in Play Maker CYCLES (30 minutes of clock each). WORDS is the button. ICON is art|glyph: an icon file name (assets/icons/) and the one or two characters shown until that file exists. MODE is a MatchModes.csv ID - that row says how long the match is and what it pays. UNDER is the line under the button. REQUIRES hides the button until it is true (same words as everywhere).
